You will work with network technologies including WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, MPLS, VLANs, routing protocols, cloud networking, firewalls, switches and routers. The role combines operational support, issue resolution and infrastructure improvements, helping employees across the organization access reliable network services. Your Responsibility Will Be To Maintain and continuously improve network infrastructure and suggest network design enhancements. Configure and support routers, switches, firewalls and related network components. Monitor network performance and take preventive measures to maintain service delivery. Collaborative network professional focused on continuous improvement We are looking for a team-oriented person who communicates clearly and enjoys working with colleagues across functions and locations. We believe that a diverse organization enables long-term performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture creates a better work environment. In this role, you will have opportunities to develop your technical capabilities, collaborate with colleagues across countries and contribute to network services that support NKT's ongoing growth and role in the green transition. You will join a collaborative team environment where learning and professional development are encouraged. "As a leader, I value people who are responsible for network reliability, collaborate openly and enjoy finding practical solutions to complex challenges. This role offers the opportunity to work with a broad range of technologies while supporting colleagues across our global organization," says Hiring Manager, Darius Martusevicius.
